title: Savings & Money Market Accounts: the owner's transfer must have posted within the contact before a reactivation date is set
content:
## Scope

This rule applies when a dormant Savings & Money Market Accounts account is to be reactivated on the strength of a transfer out that the owner makes in the contact. It states when that transfer counts as posted within the contact.

## Policy clause

1. The transfer the owner makes in the contact has posted before the reactivation date is recorded. Where it has not yet posted, no reactivation date is recorded.
2. A transfer made on a Saturday, Sunday or Federal Reserve holiday posts on the next business day, after the contact, so it has not posted within the contact.
3. The reactivation date is established under this rule only when the transfer's posted date is not after the current date, the day of the contact. Otherwise no reactivation date is established under this rule.

## Basis of decision

- **Authority.** The transfer's posted date is read from the savings account's transaction record; the day of the contact is the current date.
- **Object correlation.** The posted date tested is that of the transfer the owner makes in the contact.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

| Day of the contact | Transfer's posted date | Posted date after the day of the contact? | Reactivation date under this rule |
|---|---|---|---|
| a business day | the same day | no | established: that posted date |
| a Saturday | the following Monday, if that is a business day | yes | none |
| a Federal Reserve holiday that falls on a weekday | the next business day | yes | none |

## Points of judgement

**The owner makes the transfer on a Sunday and the receipt shows the next business day as its posted date. Can the account be reactivated in that contact under this rule?** No; the posted date is after the day of the contact, so no reactivation date is established under this rule.

**Is the day the owner calls enough on its own?** No; what counts is the transfer's posted date, and it must not be after the day of the contact.
